title: ParseX JSON Output Envelope
description: Top-level envelope every ParseX JSON-emitting Feature produces. The kind-specific body lives in 'payload'; envelope-level keys are a closed set (see additionalProperties note below).

$schema.description: URI reference to the schema defining this document's format.

contractVersion.description: ParseX JSON contract version (semver). Single project-wide constant; see schemas/VERSIONING.md.

toolVersion.description: ParseX build version that produced this document.

kind.description: Discriminator for the kind-specific payload shape. Extensible in later minor versions.

payload.description: Kind-specific body, constrained per-kind via the allOf conditional below (validationResult/diffReport payload schemas via $ref).
